steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
How to read this page opens a short guide to every box and label on this screen.
Name it and link it to the Zentrix requirement.
Land bought for ₹15 crore; 25,000 sq ft built at ₹4,500 per sq ft over 18 months.
The developer wants a 9% yield on cost.
A 10-year lease to the client, and a lease elsewhere at ₹95 to compare against.
Calculate & save — fixed formulas, not AI.
Total project cost: land, construction and soft costs.
Required rent: what the client must pay per sq ft per month for the developer to earn 9%.
Rent schedule: the rent for each lease year after escalation.
BTS vs leasing: lower total and present value for the client — built-to-suit wins here.
Assumptions are written out, e.g. interest during construction is not included.
How we calculated this: the formula version and every step, so anyone can check the maths.
Each save is a version. Change any input and recalculate — earlier versions are kept, never overwritten.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
